name: no-escaped-underscores-in-markdown-links
hook: Don't escape underscores inside markdown link brackets
body:
Markdown links in `[text](url)` format do not need escaped underscores — the brackets already disambiguate the link text from surrounding markdown. An escaped underscore `\_` inside `[(...)]` is an authoring mistake that causes Prettier to warn and fail the format check.

**Why:** Prettier's markdown parser flags `\_` in link text as an unnecessary escape. In CHANGELOGOG.md line 1709, `([#2117\_(` was causing CI to fail.

**How to apply:** When writing `([#XXXX](url))` style changelog links, use `([#XXXX](url))` — no backslash before the underscore. Prettier will not flag correctly-formatted markdown links.
why: Changelog entries with malformed markdown links cause Prettier format check to fail in CI, blocking merges. This is a common typo when manually writing changelog entries.
